_doc: Real footage library. Shared format for clips and vibe anchor stills (kind=image). redistribute=true items are committed; the rest are fetched by scripts/fetch_library.py into assets/library/fetched/ (git-ignored). Pexels/Mixkit items must have redistribute=false.
